newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on blue-chip.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on blue-chip.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Thursday due to firm sentiment on selected blue-chips, brokers said.
"Reports that some firms have revised up their 1997 net profit projections would help boost overall market sentiment, but trading volume is likely to stay small," one broker said.
Automobile conglomerate Astra and large retailer Ramayana announced on Wednesday they had revised up their net profit forecasts for 1997.
Heavyweight Telkom was likely to remain in focus on renewed market talk of a possible link-up with Singapore Telecommunications Ltd, brokers said.
Newly-listed Intiselera was also likely to remain active following a debut on Wednesday, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index ended 3.27 points, or 0.47 percent, higher at 693.04 points.
